fact: Deputy Minister for Industry and Trade Denis Londo commended BRELA for upgrading its Online Services (BOS) system, noting that five of its seven modules were operational, and directed that the remaining upgrades be completed on schedule.

e-GA says citizens can obtain various government services through the mGov mobile system by dialling *152*00#, and a CHAVITA board member says it let Deaf people pay electricity and water bills by phone.
Education Minister Adolf Mkenda launched the Integrated National Digital Library System, which handles member registration, ISBN and ISSN applications, lending and billing on web and mobile.

BRELA announced that its BRELA Online Services (BOS) system took new business name applications and industrial licence applications online from 8 April 2026, with company, patent and trademark services still on the old ORS system.
e-GA says the Government Mobile Platform (mGov) is linked to all mobile operators to deliver government services by phone; no count of services given.
